title: 减少语言的不确定性
text: 生活随笔 > 今日灵光一闪时刻，感受到了不使用模糊语言的好处，语言精准后，感觉思维活跃了很多，也能更加为自己的思想负责了。 前段时间看了《我们如何思维》这本书，里面有提到语言是思维的工具。它不仅仅是表达思想的工具，也是形成和组织思想的工具，非常重要：“*语言符号在思维中有三大核心功能：1. 从模糊不清的状态中提炼出来明确的意义；2. 将意义存储起来，随时取用；3. 在新情境中重新使用已有的意义。这三种功能紧密联系，就像一道栅栏、一个标签、一种媒介。*” 既然语言已经这么重要了，那么我们平时如何说话，来表达我们的思维也十分关键。书中后续进一步讲到，模糊的语言定义是非常有害的，“*迷糊的含义就像一锅粥或者一团糨糊，既不能提供可供分析的内容，也无法支持其他观点，既无法接受检验，**也不用承担责任**。*” 承担责任这点非常微妙，当我们说“好像”、“似乎”等词语时，潜在地意思就是，我们不必为我们说的这句话承担全部责任，毕竟丑言在先了。这样的表达，也会让我们不够有责任感，不够主动。当然生活中确实会有不确定的情况，但我们应该有诚意去尽量消除不确定性。 《非暴力沟通》里也有类似的语言的责任感的说法。这本书说是沟通，但其实更多的是在讲如何对内做好自己，然后才是对外沟通。这本书里有提到语言会让人逃避。例如，人们会说“我不得不这么做”，这样说的潜台词就是，自己是迫不得已的，自己无需为自己的行为负责；但每个人都有主导自己任何行为的权利，需要为自己的任何行为负责。这样说会丧失自己的责任感和主动性。换作“我选择这么做，是因为...”的想法或语言，就会好很多。 在减轻模糊表达后，我给AI agent指令时觉得思维清晰了不少，因为把责任更多地潜在地划到了我这边，而非AI那边。我对我自己的语言负责。而就在前几天，我还挣扎在vibe coding时头晕目眩、头脑不清晰当中。自己之前vibe coding遇到的很大的一个问题，是和AI agent等、靠、要，自己不够思维独立。增加了这个小细节后，有增加独立性的可能性。 但这是今天的一份突然感受，后续将会持续在日常生活和vibe coding中注意这个细节，观察是否真的有效。

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#34][SIGCOMM'22]SPRIGHT：从无服务计算中抽离服务器！基于eBPF的高性能事件驱动和共享内存处理
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 SIGCOMM 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## SPRIGHT: Extracting the Server from Serverless Computing! High performance eBPF-based Event-driven, Shared-memory Processing 作者单位：University of California, Riverside, CA ## 背景 无服务计算在云环境上保证了一种高效、低开销的计算能力。 ## 挑战 然而，现有的解决方案，被开源平台如Knative集成，包含了破坏无服务计算的这个目标的重量级组件。 此外，这样的无服务平台缺少数据面的优化，以实现可促进著名的微服务开发范例的高效、高性能的服务链。它们使用的用于构建服务功能链的没必要的复杂和重复的能力严重地降低了性能。 ## 工作 作者设计了SPRIGHT，一种轻量级、高性能、响应式的无服务框架。 SPRIGHT利用共享内存处理，并且戏剧性的通过避免没必要的协议处理和序列化/反序列化开销，提升了数据面的扩展性。 SPRIGHT广泛地使用eBPF进行事件驱动的处理。作者创造性的使用eBPF的socket消息机制来支持共享内存处理，其开销严格的与负载成比例。 在真实的负载下，与不间断的运行、基于轮询的DPDK相比，SPRIGHT能够在使用10倍少的CPU使用量的情况下，实现相同的数据面性能。 除此之外，eBPF通过代替重量级的无服务组件让SPRIGHT变好，让作者能够在开销可以忽略的情况下，保持函数“暖”（warm）。 ## 实验 作者的初步实验结果表明，与Knative相比，SPRIGHT在吞吐和时延上有一个数量级的提升，同时实质上减少了CPU的用量，并且避免了“冷启动”的需求。 ### 原文摘要 Serverless computing promises an efficient, low-cost compute capability in cloud environments. However, existing solutions, epitomized by open-source platforms such as Knative, include heavyweight components that undermine this goal of serverless computing. Additionally, such serverless platforms lack dataplane optimizations to achieve efficient, high-performance function chains that facilitate the popular microservices development paradigm. Their use of unnecessarily complex and duplicate capabilities for building function chains severely degrades performance. 'Cold-start' latency is another deterrent. We describe SPRIGHT, a lightweight, high-performance, responsive serverless framework. SPRIGHT exploits shared memory processing and dramatically improves the scalability of the dataplane by avoiding unnecessary protocol processing and serialization-deserialization overheads. SPRIGHT extensively leverages event-driven processing with the extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF). We creatively use eBPF's socket message mechanism to support shared memory processing, with overheads being strictly load-proportional. Compared to constantly-running, polling-based DPDK, SPRIGHT achieves the same dataplane performance with 10× less CPU usage under realistic workloads. Additionally, eBPF benefits SPRIGHT, by replacing heavyweight serverless components, allowing us to keep functions 'warm' with negligible penalty. Our preliminary experimental results show that SPRIGHT achieves _an order of magnitude_ improvement in throughput and latency compared to Knative, while substantially reducing CPU usage, and obviates the need for 'cold-start'.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#33][SIGCOMM'22]Flash：针对大规模网络设置的快速、一致数据面验证技术
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 SIGCOMM 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Flash: Fast, Consistent Data Plane Verification for Large-Scale Network Settings 作者单位：同济大学、四川大学、厦门大学、meta、耶鲁大学 ## 背景 数据面验证是减少网络中断的重要技术，研究者已经在实现快速数据面验证上取得了巨大的进步。 ## 挑战 然而，当作者应用数据面验证技术至大规模网络时，由于极端出现了两个问题。 - 现有的技术无法处理过于快的到达速度，作者称之为_更新风暴_，许多数据面更新必须在短时间内完成。 - 现有的技术无法很好的处理到达过慢的包，作者称之为_长尾更新到达_，一些交换机的更新花费很长时间到达。 ## 工作 作者提出Flash，一个可实现快速、一致数据面验证的新型系统，其更新到达包含更新风暴、长尾更新到达、或二者皆有。 特别地，Flash引入了一种叫做_快速反转模型传送_的新技术，该技术可以快速地传输一大块规则更新到一块_无冲突的更新_，来高效地处理更新风暴。 Flash也引入了一致、高效、提前探测，一个系统的机制和相关的新型算法来用不完整的信息检测数据面违规行为，来避免被长尾到达延迟。 ## 实验 作者完全实现了Flash并在不同的设置下进行了广泛的实验。 使用一个大规模网络的数据面，作者表明和最先进的per-update更新系统相比，Flash快了9000倍。 ### 原文摘要 Data plane verification can be an important technique to reduce network disruptions, and researchers have recently made significant progress in achieving fast data plane verification. However, as we apply existing data plane verification techniques to large-scale networks, two problems appear due to extremes. First, existing techniques cannot handle too-fast arrivals, which we call _update storms_, when a large number of data plane updates must be processed in a short time. Second, existing techniques cannot handle well too-slow arrivals, which we call _long-tail update arrivals_, when the updates from a number of switches take a long time to arrive. This paper presents Flash, a novel system that achieves fast, consistent data plane verification when update arrivals can include update storms, long-tail update arrivals, or both. In particular, Flash introduces a novel technique called _fast inverse model transformation_ to swiftly transform a large block of rule updates to a block of _conflict-free updates_ to efficiently handle update storms. Flash also introduces _consistent, efficient, early detection_, a systematic mechanism and associated novel algorithms to detect data plane violations with incomplete information, to avoid being delayed by long-tail arrivals. We fully implement Flash and conduct extensive evaluations under various settings. Using the data plane of a large-scale network, we show that compared with state-of-the-art sequential per-update verification systems, Flash is 9,000x faster.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#32][SIGCOMM'22]Meissa：面向可编程数据面的可扩展网络测试
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 SIGCOMM 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Meissa: Scalable Network Testing for Programmable Data Planes 作者单位：北大、阿里巴巴 ### 背景 确保可编程数据面的重要性很重要。测试（Testing）提供了全面的正确性检查，包含检查代码BUG和非代码BUG。 ### 挑战 然而，可扩展性是测试生产级规模的数据面的一个核心挑战，以实现高覆盖性。 ### 工作 本文提出了Meissa，一种针对可编程数据面的可扩展网络测试系统，有着全路径覆盖。 Meissa的核心是指定域的代码总结（code summary）技术，简化了数据面程序的控制流图，可在不牺牲覆盖的情况下进行规模测试。 代码总结将数据面程序解耦为若干pipeline，并且使用一个简洁的表示总结每个pipeline。 作者正式地证明了有代码总结的Meissa实现了100%的路径覆盖。 ### 实验 作者使用开源和生产级规模的数据面程序来评估Meissa。 评估表明： - Messia可以测试不被当前最新工作所支持的生产级规模的数据面程序 - 除P4代码BUG外，Messia不仅能识别已知的非代码BUG，还能检测之前不知道的非代码BUG。 作者也展示了一些Messia在生产级可编程数据面的真实用例。 ### 原文摘要 Ensuring the correctness of programmable data planes is important. Testing offers comprehensive correctness checking, including detecting both code bugs and non-code bugs. However, scalability is a key challenge for testing production-scale data planes to achieve high coverage. This paper presents Meissa, a_scalable_network testing system for programmable data planes with_full_path coverage. The core of Meissa is a domain-specific_code summary_technique that simplifies the control flow graph of a data plane program for scalable testing without sacrificing coverage. Code summary decomposes a data plane program into individual pipelines, and summarizes each pipeline with a succinct representation. We formally prove that Meissa with code summary achieves_100% path coverage_. We use both open-source and production-scale data plane programs to evaluate Meissa. The evaluation shows that (_i_) Meissa is able to test production-scale data plane programs that cannot be supported by state-of-the-art efforts, and_(ii)_besides P4 code bugs, Meissa is able to not only identify known non-code bugs, but also detect previously-unknown non-code bugs. We also share in this paper several real cases tested by Meissa in a production programmable data plane.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#31][ATC'22]AddrMiner：一个全面的全球活跃IPv6地址发现系统
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 ATC 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## AddrMiner: A Comprehensive Global Active IPv6 Address Discovery System 作者单位：BNRist，清华大学，泉城实验室，北京交通大学 ## 背景 快速的互联网范围（Internet-wide）扫描对网络态势感知和资产评估十分重要。 ## 挑战 然而，广阔的IPv6地址空间让暴力搜索变得不可行。尽管最先进的技术已经做了有效的尝试，这些方法还是不能在无种子区域（seedless regions）上生效，且探测效率在有种区域上较低。 ## 工作&实验 本文介绍了AddrMiner，一种系统和全面的全球活跃IPv6地址探测系统。作者将IPv6地址空间域根据种子地址的数量分为了三类，以从无到有、从少到多的发现活跃的IPv6地址。 对于没有种子的区域，作者提出AddrMiner-N，使用一个组织相关策略来发掘活跃IP地址。它填充了在无种子域中地址探测的间隔，发现覆盖被BGP宣告的86.4K个IPv6前缀，占被探测前缀的81.6%。 对于种子较少的区域，作者提出AddrMiner-F，利用相似的匹配策略来进一步探测活跃的IP地址。活跃IP地址探测的命中率相较于现有的算法，提升了70%~150%。 对于充足种子的区域，作者提出了AddrMiner-S来基于强化学习动态地产生目标地址。它相比于最先进的算法几乎提升了一倍的命中率。 最后，作者部署了AddrMiner并且通过持续13个月的探测，发现了2.1亿个活跃的IPv6地址，包括1.7亿个去别名（de-aliased）的活跃地址和0.5亿个别名地址。作者想要通过发布AddrMiner且共享他们的数据，来为公众进一步开启IPv6测量研究的大门。 ### 原文摘要 Fast Internet-wide scanning is essential for network situational awareness and asset evaluation. However, the vast IPv6 address space makes brute-force scanning infeasible. Although state-of-the-art techniques have made effective attempts, these methods do not work in seedless regions, while the detection efficiency is low in regions with seeds. Moreover, the constructed hitlists with low coverage cannot truly represent the active IPv6 address landscape of the Internet. This paper introduces AddrMiner, a global active IPv6 address probing system, making IPv6 active address probing systematic, comprehensive, and economical. We divide the IPv6 address space regions into three kinds according to the number of seed addresses and propose a probing algorithm for each of them. For the regions with no seeds, we propose AddrMiner-N, leveraging an organization association strategy to mine active addresses. It finds active addresses covering 86.4K BGP prefixes, accounting for 81.6\\% of the probed BGP prefixes. For the regions with few seeds, we propose AddrMiner-F, utilizing a similarity matching strategy to probe active addresses further. The hit rate of active address probing is improved by 70\\%-150\\% compared to existing algorithms. For the regions with sufficient seeds, we propose AddrMiner-S to generate target addresses based on reinforcement learning dynamically. It nearly doubles the hit rate compared to the state-of-the-art algorithms. Finally, we deploy AddrMiner and discover 2.1 billion active IPv6 addresses, including 1.7 billion de-aliased active addresses and 0.4 billion aliased addresses, through continuous probing for 13 months. We would like to further open the door of IPv6 measurement studies by publicly releasing AddrMiner and sharing our data.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#30][ATC'22]没那么简单：21世纪的email发送
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 ATC 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Not that Simple: Email Delivery in the 21st Century 作者单位：SBA Research，University of Vienna，TU Wien，Max-Planck-Institut für Informatik ## 背景 在过去二十年间，关于email及其安全性的RFC数量以及从小于100爆炸增长至接近500。这将SMTP协议（Simple Mail Transfer Protocol）嵌入到一个相互依存且与交付有关的标准的树中。 ## 工作 在本文中，作者调查了真实世界的部署与这些日益复杂的交付和安全选择间的跟进情况。 为深入了解除生态中的巨头（Gmail、Outlook等）email发送的情况，作者让人们向11个不太的配置好的目标域发送email。 作者的测量允许他们评估email发送的核心方面，包括安全特性、DNS配置和在不同类型的提供商在IP版本支持方面的情况。 ## 实验 作者发现新技术通常没有被充分支持，即使是在大型提供商那。 例如，在65.4%的email提供商能够通过IPv6解析主机的同时，只有44.3%可以通过IPv6发送邮件。 考虑安全特性，作者注意到少于一半（41.5%）的提供商依赖于DNSSEC验证解析器，并且加密大多是机会主义的（opportunistic），89.7%的提供商接受无效的证书。TLSA，作为一种基于DNS的证书验证方法，在作者的研究中仅仅被31.7%的提供商所使用。 最后，作者将注意力放在了现代标准对大量不请自来（unsolicited）的邮件（SPAM）的影响。作者发现灰名单是很有效的，在不影响正常发送的情况下，能够减少几乎一半的SPAM。然而，有趣的是，SPAM发送现在似乎聚焦于明文IPv4链接，让仅支持IPv6、强制TLS的入向email服务器为一个更加高效的反SPAM措施----尽管它也意味着拒绝大多数合法email。 ### 原文摘要 Over the past two decades, the number of RFCs related to email and its security has exploded from below 100 to nearly 500. This embedded the Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) into a tree of interdependent and delivery-relevant standards. In this paper, we investigate how far real-world deployments keep up with this increasing complexity of delivery- and security options. To gain an in-depth picture of email delivery apart from the giants in the ecosystem (Gmail, Outlook, etc.), we engage people to send emails to eleven differently configured target domains. Our measurements allow us to evaluate core aspects of email delivery, including security features, DNS configuration, and IP version support on the sending side across different types of providers. We find that novel technologies are often insufficiently supported, even by large providers. For example, while 65.4\\% of email providers can resolve hosts via IPv6, only 44.3\\% can also deliver emails via IPv6. Concerning security features, we observe that less than half (41.5\\%) of all providers rely on DNSSEC validating resolvers, and encryption is mostly opportunistic, with 89.7\\% of providers accepting invalid certificates. TLSA, as a DNS-based certificate verification method, is only used by 31.7\\% of the providers in our study. Finally, we turned our eye to the impact modern standards have on unsolicited bulk email (SPAM). We found that greylisting is effective, reducing the SPAM volume by roughly half while not impacting regular delivery. However, and interestingly, SPAM delivery currently seems to focus on plaintext IPv4 connections, making IPv6-only, TLS-enforcing inbound email servers a more effective anti-SPAM measure – even though it also means rejecting a major portion of legitimate emails.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#29][ATC'22]为高性能网络仿真选择 Linux 进程
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 ATC 技术札记 ## Co-opting Linux Processes for High-Performance Network Simulation 作者单位：Naval Research Laboratory，Tor Project，Georgetown University ## 背景 网络实验工具在开发、评估、测试分布式系统的过程中非常重要。 ## 挑战 最先进的仿真（simulation）工具要么在大规模时非常低效率，要么被不可忽视的架构挑战所限制，阻止了其广泛使用。 ## 工作 在本文中，作者提出了Phantom（与Shadow v2是一回事，但本文中使用Phantom作为方案）的设计和实现，Phantom是进行分布式系统实验的新型工具。 在Phantom，一个离散事件网络仿真器直接将未经修改的应用程序作为Linux进程执行，并创新地综合了高效进程控制、系统调用interposition和数据传输方法，以将进程融合进仿真环境中。 ## 实验 实验表明，在大规模P2P基准测试中，在 Phantom最多比Shadow快2.2倍，最多比NS-3快3.4倍，最多比gRaIL快43倍，同时在大型ToR网络仿真中，提供了与Shadow相似的性能。 ### 原文摘要 Network experimentation tools are vitally important to the process of developing, evaluating, and testing distributed systems. The state-of-the-art simulation tools are either prohibitively inefficient at large scales or are limited by nontrivial architectural challenges, inhibiting their widespread adoption. In this paper, we present the design and implementation of Phantom, a novel tool for conducting distributed system experiments. In Phantom, a discrete-event network simulator directly executes unmodified applications as Linux processes and innovatively synthesizes efficient process control, system call interposition, and data transfer methods to co-opt the processes into the simulation environment. Our evaluation demonstrates that Phantom is up to 2.2× faster than Shadow, up to 3.4× faster than NS-3, and up to 43× faster than gRaIL in large P2P benchmarks while offering performance comparable to Shadow in large Tor network simulations.

title: 【CCF-CSP】202203-2. 出行计划
text: 差分 CCF-CSP 技术札记 # 题目内容 【CCF-CSP】202203-2. 出行计划 # 思路分析 ## 方法一：普通法（仅能获得70分） ### 思路 先将出行计划（进入场所时刻、需要`C`时刻内的核酸）依次存入数组中，然后根据所查询的做核酸的时刻，依次计算出各个出行计划是否在`time_min`和`time_max`的区间内（即核酸有效期），其中： - `time_min`为出核酸的时刻，等于做核酸的时刻+等待时长 - `time_max`为核酸对于该场所的过期时刻，等于做核酸的时刻+等待时长+`C` ### 复杂度 下面分析复杂度。设出行计划、查询个数、等待时间为N，且$$N\in[0, 10^5]$$，则： - 存储出行计划需要O(N) - 遍历查询并依次比较要两次遍历，因此需要O(N^2) 所以整体的复杂度是O(N^2)，当数据量很大的时候运行会超时，因此只能获得70分。 ## 方法二：差分数组 ### 思路 上层思想：建立一个数组`A`，存储所有时刻上有多少场所可以进入，这里的时刻指的是出核酸的时刻。 具体实现时，需要计算每个场所对应的可进入时间区间。如计划100时刻去某场所，而该场所要求24小时核酸，说明出核酸的时刻在100-24+1=77到100之间都是能够进入该场所的，那么就需要令A的\[77,100\]下标内的值都加一。 在实现A内的部分区间统一加一时，如果使用正常的遍历区间内的元素相加，时间复杂度会达到O(N)，因此这里使用了差分数组。 ### 差分数组 差分数组就是一个对应于a\[N\]的数组b\[N\]，满足a\[i\] = b\[1\] + b\[2\] + … + b\[i\]，设置这样的数组后，“部分区间统一加一”的这个操作复杂度就能由O(N)降为O(1)。例如，区间\[3,6\]统一加一，只需令b\[3\]+1，b\[7\]+1，这样a的对应区间就是全部加一的。 ### 复杂度 依然设出行计划、查询个数、等待时间为N，且$$N\in[0, 10^5]$$，则： - 遍历出行计划并维护数组A，O(N) - 将差分数组整理为正常数组，O(K)，其中$$K=4*10^5+1$$ - 遍历查询并直接输出结果，O(N) 所以整体复杂度是O(N)，虽然K的值较大，但和庞大的O(N^2)比起来不值一提。 # 代码 ## 方法一 ```cpp #include #include // 70分 using namespace std; struct Plan { int ptime; int interval_require; }; int main() { int plan_num_n, query_num_m, wait_time_k; cin >> plan_num_n >> query_num_m >> wait_time_k; struct Plan plan; vector plans; int queried_time, time_min, time_max; int query_result; for (int i=0; i> plan.ptime >> plan.interval_require; plans.push_back(plan); } for (int i=0; i> queried_time; time_min = queried_time + wait_time_k; for(struct Plan plan : plans) { if (plan.ptime >= time_min && plan.ptime <= queried_time + \ wait_time_k + plan.interval_require - 1) { query_result += 1; } } cout << query_result << endl; } return 0; } ``` ## 方法二 ```cpp #include #include // 100分 // 满分题解：https://www.cfanz.cn/mobile/resource/detail/NGMVowMgZLjZJ // 差分算法：https://www.jianshu.com/p/444096786e49 using namespace std; const int TIME_NUM_N = 4e5 + 1; int time2placenum[TIME_NUM_N]; // 差分数组，表示某时刻下可进入场所的个数 // 将数组的[left, right]之间的值都加上value inline void increase_diff_array(int left, int right, int value) { time2placenum[left] += value; time2placenum[right + 1] -= value; } int main() { int plan_num_n, query_num_m, wait_time_k; cin >> plan_num_n >> query_num_m >> wait_time_k; int place_time_t, interval_c; int queried_time, time_min, time_max; for (int i=0; i> place_time_t >> interval_c; time_min = max(place_time_t - interval_c + 1, 1); time_max = place_time_t; increase_diff_array(time_min, time_max, 1); } for (int i=1; i> queried_time; cout << time2placenum[queried_time + wait_time_k] << endl; } return 0; } ``` # 收获 以前一直觉得算法没卵用，今天这个例子是生活中确实存在的，用一些算法上的例子就能让程序的运行快上不少，证明算法还是有点卵用。 当然，这里假设时间是有限的，现实中可能做不到这样。

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#28][SIGCOMM'22]DeepQueueNet：实现具有数据包粒度可见性的可扩展和通用网络性能估计
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 SIGCOMM 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## DeepQueueNet: Towards Scalable and Generalized Network Performance Estimation with Packet-level Visibility 作者单位：华为理论实验室、中关村实验室、香港中文大学、山东计算机科学中心（济南国家超算中心）、多伦多大学 ### 背景 网络仿真器是网络操作员的必要工具，可以协助进行一些重要工作如容量规划、拓扑设计和参数调优。 ### 挑战 著名的仿真器都基于离散事件仿真，并且他们的性能不随着现代网络的规模而扩展。近期，基于深度学习的技术被引入以解决规模扩展问题，但是，正如作者的实验证明，他们在仿真结果上有着较弱的可视性，并且不能在多种场景上通用。 ### 工作 在本文中，作者将可扩展和通用的连续仿真技术与离散事件仿真结合，以在提供包级别的可视化的同时，实现高可扩展性。 作者从一个坚实的队列理论模型出发，小心地分辨出数学棘手的或计算昂贵的部分，并仅仅对它们使用深度神经网络（DNN）建模。 作者的方法，DeepQueueNet，结合了网络的先验知识，支持任意拓扑和设备流量管理机制（在给定充足的流量数据的情况下）。 ### 实验 作者的实验表明DeepQueueNet实现了随着GPU数量近似线性的加速，并且在所有场景下，它对平均和99th RTT的估计准确性的表现优于现有的端到端性能估计器 ### 原文摘要 Network simulators are an essential tool for network operators, and can assist important tasks such as capacity planning, topology design, and parameter tuning. Popular simulators are all based on discrete event simulation, and their performance does not scale with the size of modern networks. Recently, deep-learning-based techniques are introduced to solve the scalability problem, but, as we show with experiments, they have poor visibility in their simulation results, and cannot generalize to diverse scenarios. In this work, we combine scalable and generalized continuous simulation techniques with discrete event simulation to achieve high scalability, while providing packet-level visibility. We start from a solid queueing-theoretic modeling of modern networks, and carefully identify the mathematically-intractable or computationally-expensive parts, only which are then modeled using deep neural networks (DNN). Dubbed_DeepQueueNet_, our approach combines prior knowledge of networks, and supports arbitrary topology and device traffic management mechanisms (given sufficient training data). Our extensive experiments show that DeepQueueNet achieves near-linear speedup in the number of GPUs, and its estimation accuracy for average and 99th percentile round-trip time outperforms existing end-to-end DNN-based performance estimators in all scenarios.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#27][SIGCOMM'22]SimBricks：使用模块化仿真评估端对端网络系统
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 SIGCOMM 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## SimBricks: End-to-End Network System Evaluation with Modular Simulation 作者单位：德国马克斯·普朗克软件系统研究所、新加坡国立大学 ### 背景 物理testbed中，全系统的“端到端”测量是网络系统评估的黄金标准，但通常是不可行的。因为物理testbed不可行，我们通常使用仿真（simulation）来做评估。 ### 挑战 不幸的是，现有的仿真器对于端到端仿真而言是不充分的，因为它们既不能仿真所有组件，也不能充分地仿真组件的细节。 ### 工作 作者通过模块化仿真来解决此问题，在为每个用例调整的虚拟端到端实验床上，针对不同的组件（包括处理器、内存、设备和网络），灵活地组合和连接多种现有的仿真器。 作者的架构，SimBricks，结合了： - 针对可扩展性和模块化的定义良好的组件接口 - 针对本地和分布式仿真的高效通信通道 - 一种共同设计（co-designed）的高效同步机制，用于跨仿真器精确计时 ### 实验 作者展示了SimBricks可以扩展至1000个仿真主机，每个主机都运行着包括Linux在内的完整软件栈，并且它能够使用现有的NIC和交换机的RTL实现来仿真testbeds。 作者也在SimBricks上复现了先前工作（包括拥塞控制、NIC架构、网内计算）中的核心发现。 ### 原文摘要 Full system "end-to-end" measurements in physical testbeds are the gold standard for network systems evaluation but are often not feasible. When physical testbeds are not available we frequently turn to simulation for evaluation. Unfortunately, existing simulators are insufficient for end-to-end evaluation, as they either cannot simulate all components, or simulate them with inadequate detail. We address this through modular simulation, flexibly combining and connecting multiple existing simulators for different components, including processor and memory, devices, and network, into virtual end-to-end testbeds tuned for each use-case. Our architecture, SimBricks, combines well-defined component interfaces for extensibility and modularity, efficient communication channels for local and distributed simulation, and a co-designed efficient synchronization mechanism for accurate timing across simulators. We demonstrate SimBricks scales to 1000 simulated hosts, each running a full software stack including Linux, and that it can simulate testbeds with existing NIC and switch RTL implementations. We also reproduce key findings from prior work in congestion control, NIC architecture, and in-network computing in SimBricks.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#26][NSDI'22]近似遥测请求的动态调度
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Dynamic Scheduling of Approximate Telemetry Queries ### 背景 网络遥测系统提供了重要的网络状态可视性。尽管大家在利用可编程交换机硬件在高和随时间变化的流量负载上扩展遥测系统方面，已经做出了很多的努力，在动态性的事实（如在流量的组成和查询的数量和类型）面前，高效地利用限制的硬件资源却鲜有人关注。这些动态性都对资源需求和查询的准确性有着影响。 ### 挑战 在本文中，作者认为这个动态性问题促使将遥测系统重塑（reframing）为资源调度器---与最先进的方案最大的不同。 更具体的，遥测系统应该自行实时决定在数据面上执行主动查询集合的时间和时长，而不是统计方式来在软硬件上平台划分查询。 ### 工作 为了达成这个目的，作者提出了一个高效的近似和调度算法，在查询执行方面，暴露了准确性和时延的权衡，以减少硬件资源用量。 ### 实验 作者通过构建DynATOS，一个通过围绕ASIC编程的重配置方法建立的硬件原型系统，评估了其算法。 在单交换机上，作者表明他们的方法可以满足查询准确性和目标要求的情况下，在对待流量动态性时更加具有鲁棒性，并且可以执行由多个复杂的并发和顺序查询组成的动态工作负载。 ### 原文摘要 Network telemetry systems provide critical visibility into the state of networks. While significant progress has been made by leveraging programmable switch hardware to scale these systems to high and time-varying traffic workloads, less attention has been paid towards efficiently utilizing limited hardware resources in the face of dynamics such as the composition of traffic as well as the number and types of queries running at a given point in time. Both these dynamics have implications on resource requirements and query accuracy. In this paper, we argue that this dynamics problem motivates reframing telemetry systems as resource schedulers---a significant departure from state-of-the-art. More concretely, rather than statically partition queries across hardware and software platforms, telemetry systems ought to decide on their own and at runtime when and for how long to execute the set of active queries on the data plane. To this end, we propose an efficient approximation and scheduling algorithm that exposes accuracy and latency tradeoffs with respect to query execution to reduce hardware resource usage. We evaluate our algorithm by building DynATOS, a hardware prototype built around a reconfigurable approach to ASIC programming. We show that our approach is more robust than state-of-the-art methods to traffic dynamics and can execute dynamic workloads comprised of multiple concurrent and sequential queries of varied complexities on a single switch while meeting per-query accuracy and latency goals.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#25][NSDI'22]加速跨深度学习框架中数据并行训练的集群通信
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Accelerating Collective Communication in Data Parallel Training across Deep Learning Frameworks ### 工作 本工作在Horovod内开发了新的技术，Horovod是一种跨深度学习框架的支持数据并行训练的通用通信库。 特别地，作者通过实现了新的协作方案来提升Horovod的控制面，该协作方案能够获取典型数据并行创建模式的优点，即在一组固定的张量梯度上重复执行集合运算。使用缓存策略，作者在一次典型训练过程中，只执行一次Horovod的现有worker协作逻辑，使用一个用了缓存数据和用于剩余的训练时间的比特向量的全局交集的高效分布式编排策略来代替它。 接着，作者引入了一个针对终端用户显式将集体操作分组的特性，从而实现对通信缓冲区大小更精细的控制。 ### 实验 作者为评估其提出的方法，在一个世界级的超级计算机---Summit上进行了实验。 - 作者将其方法与Horovod的原始设计做了对比，在6000个GPU上的规模上观测到了2倍的性能提升。 - 作者也将它们与tf.distribute和torch.DDP做了对比，在最多1536个GPU上，分别实现了12%以上和差不多的性能。 - 作者在典型的HPC设置下，将自己的解决方案与BytePS对比，在768个GPU规模上，实现了约20%的性能提升。 - 最后，在一个科学应用（STEMDL）上使用最多27600个GPU（整个Summit）上进行了测试，结果表明，作者实现了0.93的近似线性规模性，在FP16的精度下有着1.54exaflops的持续性能。 ### 原文摘要 This work develops new techniques within Horovod, a generic communication library supporting data parallel training across deep learning frameworks. In particular, we improve the Horovod control plane by implementing a new coordination scheme that takes advantage of the characteristics of the typical data parallel training paradigm, namely the repeated execution of collectives on the gradients of a fixed set of tensors. Using a caching strategy, we execute Horovod’s existing coordinator-worker logic only once during a typical training run, replacing it with a more efficient decentralized orchestration strategy using the cached data and a global intersection of a bitvector for the remaining training duration. Next, we introduce a feature for end users to explicitly group collective operations, enabling finer grained control over the communication buffer sizes. To evaluate our proposed strategies, we conduct experiments on a world-class supercomputer — Summit. We compare our proposals to Horovod’s original design and observe 2x performance improvement at a scale of 6000 GPUs; we also compare them against tf.distribute and torch.DDP and achieve 12% better and comparable performance, respectively, using up to 1536 GPUs; we compare our solution against BytePS in typical HPC settings and achieve about 20% better performance on a scale of 768 GPUs. Finally, we test our strategies on a scientific application (STEMDL) using up to 27,600 GPUs (the entire Summit) and show that we achieve a near-linear scaling of 0.93 with a sustained performance of 1.54 exaflops (with standard error +- 0.02) in FP16 precision.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#24][NSDI'22]Configanator：一种提升CDN性能的数据驱动方法
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Configanator: A Data-driven Approach to Improving CDN Performance ### 背景 web服务协议栈在持续的演进，以处理网络基础架构中的技术偏移和网站的复杂性。作为这种演进的结果，web服务可以使用众多的协议和配置参数来解决很多实际的网络环境。 ### 挑战 然而，如今，尽管终端用户的网络和设备有着很大的多样性，大部分内容提供商采用了一刀切（one-size-fits-all）的方法来为其面向用户的web服务来配置网络栈（或者最多稍作调整）。 ### 工作 在本文呢中，作者演示了维持现状会导致次优的性能，论证了一个新的框架，该框架扩展了现有的CDN架构，以提供对web服务配置参数的可编程控制。 作者设计了一个数据驱动的框架Configanator，该框架利用链接中的数据来分辨它们的网络和设备特征，并且学习最优的配置参数来提升终端用户体验。 ### 实验 作者在5个trace上（包括一个从全球内容提供商的trace）评估了Configanator，通过两个实时部署评估了真实用户的性能提升。结果表明，Configanator在的多个网站和网络中，提升了32-67%的尾部（第95%）web性能。 ### 原文摘要 The web serving protocol stack is constantly evolving to tackle the technological shifts in networking infrastructure and website complexity. As a result of this evolution, web servers can use a plethora of protocols and configuration parameters to address a variety of realistic network conditions. Yet, today, despite the significant diversity in end-user networks and devices, most content providers have adopted a “one-size-fits-all” approach to configuring the networking stack of their user-facing web servers (or at best employ moderate tuning). In this paper, we demonstrate that the status quo results in sub-optimal performance and argue for a novel framework that extends existing CDN architectures to provide programmatic control over a web server’s configuration parameters. We designed a data-driven framework, Configanator, that leverages data across connections to identify their network and device characteristics, and learn the optimal configuration parameters to improve end-user performance. We evaluate Configanator on five traces, including one from a global content provider, and evaluate the performance improvements for real users through two live deployments. Our results show that Configanator improves tail (p95) web performance by 32-67% across diverse websites and networks.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#23][NSDI'22]运行时可编程交换机
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Runtime Programmable Switches ### 背景 将网络编程以添加、删除、修改功能已经变为了我们社区的一个长期目标。 ### 挑战 不幸的是，在今天的可编程网络中，变化的速度被一个实际的基础屏障所限制，需要管理操作如排空（drain）或重路由目标节点目标节点上的流量，将数据面重新成像（re-imaging）和重新将流量导回原来的路由。 ### 工作 作者的项目研究了使未来网络运行时可编程（runtime programmable）的技术。 FlexCore使得在最小的资源开销、不打断服务的情况下，交换机数据面运行时可以进行部分重配置，且数据包的处理是有一致性保障的。 它有着交换机架构、部分重配置原语、重配置算法、一致性保证方面的考量。 ### 实验 仿真结果表明了运行时可编程交换机的可行性和好处。 ### 原文摘要 Programming the network to add, remove, and modify functions has been a longstanding goal in our community. Unfortunately, in today’s programmable networks, the velocity of change is restricted by a practical yet fundamental barrier: reprogramming network devices is an intrusive change, requiring management operations such as draining and rerouting traffic from the target node, re-imaging the data plane, and redirecting traffic back to its original route. This project investigates design techniques to make future networks runtime programmable. FlexCore enables partial reconfiguration of switch data planes at runtime with minimum resource overheads, without service disruption, while processing packets with consistency guarantees. It involves design considerations in switch architectures, partial reconfiguration primitives, reconfiguration algorithms, as well as consistency guarantees. Our evaluation results demonstrate the feasibility and benefits of runtime programmable switches.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#22][NSDI'22]如何诊断丰富的终端主机栈中的纳秒级网络延迟
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## How to diagnose nanosecond network latencies in rich end-host stacks ### 背景 低延迟网络栈已经将主机内的网络延迟降低至微秒制（microsecond-regime）。 ### 挑战 然而，端主机分析器（profiler）有着高开销，导致它们只能用于确认一个假设，而无法在第一现场诊断问题。事实上，作者调研了20个低延迟的网络项目，其中的每一个都用的自己的分析工具，而不是使用现有的分析器。 ### 工作 本文展示了如何去构建一个低开销、全栈覆盖的时延诊断工具，可以用来辨识而不只是确认端主机中时延的来源。 独特的测量方法以纳秒级的准确度，通过调和（reconciling）CPU和网卡硬件在多个时间域（网络和CPU）的分析器trace，重建了网络消息在端主机内的生命周期。 作者揭示了内核栈和用户栈上的意想不到的时延来源。 ### 实验 作者通过使用他们的实现---NSight，展现了上述能力，来系统地辨别和移除memcached中的性能开销，以40的因子（从2.2ms到41us） 减少了第99.9%的时延。 ### 原文摘要 Low-latency network stacks have brought down network latencies within end-hosts to the _microsecond-regime_. However, end-host profilers have such high overheads that they are useful only to confirm a hypothesis, not to diagnose a problem in the first place. Indeed, every one of twenty low-latency network projects we surveyed rolled their own analysis tools instead of using an existing profiler. This paper shows how to build a latency diagnosis tool with full-stack coverage and low overhead that can identify, not just confirm, sources of latency in end hosts. The unique measurement methodology reconstructs network-message lifetimes within end hosts with nanosecond precision, by reconciling CPU and NIC hardware profiling traces across multiple time domains (network and CPU). It uncovers unexpected latency sources in both kernel and user-space stacks. We demonstrate these capabilities by using our implementation, NSight, to systematically identify and remove performance overheads in memcached, reducing 99.9th percentile latency by a factor of 40 from 2:2 ms to 41 μs.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#21][NSDI'22]工业机械臂的网内速率控制
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## In-Network Velocity Control of Industrial Robot Arms ### 背景 随着可编程数据面的出现，网内计算（[In-network computing](http://link.zhihu.com/?target=https%3A//eng.ox.ac.uk/computing/projects/in-network-computing/)）已经兴起为一种新的计算范式。将计算从传统的服务器计算迁移至网络的好处已经在不同的应用中有所演示。 ### 工作 在本文中，作者认为，可编程数据面应该是云和边缘云机器人科学的关键使能技术，可以赋予工业互联网新生。 作者提出了一种针对实时机器人控制的网内方法，将时延敏感型任务从高层的控制进程中分离出来。 提出的系统将实时机械臂速率控制卸载至P4可编程数据面上，并且仅仅在工业控制器上保持高层控制和规划。 这样的分离让工业控制能够部署在非实时环境中，例如运行在远程云获者边缘基础设施上的虚拟机或服务容器。 ### 实验 作者演示了他们的方法可以使用单个P4交换机流畅地控制机械臂100s，允许在轨迹间快速地重路由；通过设计和支持工业系统有中即插即用地新机器人设备，解决了多机器人间地精确同步问题，减少了操作和管理开销。 ### 原文摘要 In-network computing has emerged as a new computational paradigm made possible with the advent of programmable data planes. The benefits of moving computations traditionally performed by servers to the network have recently been demonstrated through different applications. In this paper, we argue that programmable data planes could be a key technology enabler of cloud and edge-cloud robotics, and in general could revitalize industrial networking. We propose an in-network approach for real-time robot control that separates delay sensitive tasks from high-level control processes. The proposed system offloads real-time velocity control of robot arms to P4-enabled programmable data planes and only keeps the high-level control and planning at the industrial controller. This separation allows the deployment of industrial control in non-real-time environments like virtual machines and service containers running in a remote cloud or an edgecomputing infrastructure. In addition, we also demonstrate that our method can smoothly control 100s of robot arms with a single P4-switch, enables fast reroute between trajectories, solves the precise synchronization of multiple robots by design and supports the plug-and-play deployment of new robot devices in the industrial system, reducing both operational and management costs.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#20][NSDI'22]Justitia: 在硬件内核旁路网络上的软件多租户
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Justitia: Software Multi-Tenancy in Hardware Kernel-Bypass Networks ### 背景 内核旁路网络（Kernel-Bypass Network, KBN）正在成为现代数据中心的新标准。基于硬件的KBN将所有的内核数据面任务卸载至专门的网卡，以实现比基于软件的KBN更好的延迟和CPU效率，但是它也剥夺了操作员对网络共享策略的控制权。 ### 挑战 在多租户硬件KBN上提供策略支持带来了独特的挑战---即，保留极低的延迟和低CPU开销、找到一个定义较好的调节点、重新思考流量整形器。 ### 工作 提出了Justitia，在三个核心设计方面来解决这些挑战： - 使用消息级别的整形来将连接分离 - 基于发送端的资源调解，以及接收端的更新 - 被动延迟监控 使用延迟目标作为它的旋钮（knob），Justitia支持多租户策略，例如可预测延迟和公平/加权资源分配。 ### 实验 仿真结果表明，Justitia可以在利用率轻微下降的情况下，高效地对延迟敏感型应用进行隔离，并且能保证其余的吞吐和带宽没有被不公平的对待。 ### 原文摘要 Kernel-bypass networking (KBN) is becoming the new norm in modern datacenters. While hardware-based KBN offloads all dataplane tasks to specialized NICs to achieve better latency and CPU efficiency than software-based KBN, it also takes away the operator’s control over network sharing policies. Providing policy support in multi-tenant hardware KBN brings unique challenges – namely, preserving ultra-low latency and low CPU cost, finding a well-defined point of mediation, and rethinking traffic shapers. We present Justitia to address these challenges with three key design aspects: (i) Split Connection with message-level shaping, (ii) sender-based resource mediation together with receiver-side updates, and (iii) passive latency monitoring. Using a latency target as its knob, Justitia enables multi-tenancy policies such as predictable latencies and fair/weighted resource sharing. Our evaluation shows Justitia can effectively isolate latency-sensitive applications at the cost of slightly decreased utilization and ensure that throughput and bandwidth of the rest are not unfairly penalized.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#19][NSDI'22]HeteroSketch：在异质和动态的网络中协调全网监控
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## HeteroSketch: Coordinating Network-wide Monitoring in Heterogeneous and Dynamic Networks ### 背景 网络测量和监控是网络管理里非常重要的一环。sketch算法以及网络元素的可编程性越来越高，高精度、网络范围的遥测触手可及。 ### 挑战 - 可编程硬件的异构型 - 可用资源和资源需求的动态变化 使得网络network-wide的监控不切实际。 ### 工作 HeteroSketch，由两个主要组件组成的架构。 - 一个预测工具，可通过预测sketch算法的性能，自动地量化任意硬件的能力 - 一个优化框架，在考虑异构设备能力的情况下，决定测量任务的放置以及设备的资源分配，来满足监控目标 Hetero能够使用新型集群算法来优化大型网络（超过40,000个节点）的部署，并且能够令网络拓扑、流量、资源动态快速响应。 ### 实验 实验表明HeteroSketch在维护监控性能、覆盖和准确性地情况下，能够减少20%~60%的开销。 ### 原文摘要 Network monitoring and measurement have always been critical components of network management. Recent developments in sketch-based monitoring techniques and the deployment opportunities arising from the increasing programmability of network elements (e.g., programmable switches, SmartNICs, and software switches) have made the possibility of accurate, detailed, network-wide telemetry tantalizingly within reach. However, the wide heterogeneity of the programmable hardware and dynamic changes in both resources available and resources needed for monitoring over time make existing approaches to network-wide monitoring impractical. We present HeteroSketch, a framework that consists of two main components: (1) a profiling tool that automatically quantifies the capabilities of arbitrary hardware by predicting their performance for sketching algorithms, and (2) an optimization framework that decides placement of measurement tasks and resource allocation for devices to meet monitoring goals while considering heterogeneous device capabilities. HeteroSketch enables optimized deployments for large networks (> 40,000 nodes) using a novel clustering approach and enables prompt responses to network topology, traffic, query, and resource dynamics. Our evaluation shows that HeteroSketch reduces resource overheads by 20-60% compared to prior art, while maintaining monitoring performance, coverage, and accuracy.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#18][NSDI'22]cISP: 一种光速的互联网服务提供者
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## cISP: A Speed-of-Light Internet Service Provider ### 背景 低延迟是众多交互型网络应用的需求。 ### 挑战 然而互联网没有针对延迟做优化。 ### 工作 探索了广域网的设计，能够以近乎真空中的光速来移动数据。 作者的cISP设计使用非常接近大圆路径的自由空间微波无线连接来增强互联网的光纤。 cISP在提供极低延迟的同时，还考虑了许多其它的实际因素，包括可用的传输塔、数据包入队等。 ### 实验 对比在中长距离、光速下使用大圆路径，作者表明在美国和欧洲的cISP实例能实现平均其5%的延迟。 进一步地，在近乎光速的算法交易上进行的实验和在其终端上对交易数据进行的分析表明，即使在恶劣天气下，微波网络可靠地比光纤网络快。 最后，作者估计这样的网络带来的经济价值讲持续的超出它们的花销。 ### 原文摘要 Low latency is a requirement for a variety of interactive network applications. The Internet, however, is not optimized for latency. We thus explore the design of wide-area networks that move data at nearly the speed of light in vacuum. Our cISP design augments the Internet’s fiber with free-space microwave wireless connectivity over paths very close to great-circle paths. cISP addresses the fundamental challenge of simultaneously providing ultra-low latency while accounting for numerous practical factors ranging from transmission tower availability to packet queuing. We show that instantiations of cISP across the United States and Europe would achieve mean latencies within 5% of that achievable using great-circle paths at the speed of light, over medium and long distances. Further, using experiments conducted on a nearly-speed-of-light algorithmic trading network, together with an analysis of trading data at its end points, we show that microwave networks are reliably faster than fiber networks even in inclement weather. Finally, we estimate that the economic value of such networks would substantially exceed their expense.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#17][NSDI'22]Check-N-Run: 一个针对训练深度学习推荐模型的checkpointing系统
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Check-N-Run: a Checkpointing System for Training Deep Learning Recommendation Models ### 背景 checkpoints在训练长时间运行的机器学习（ML）模型中起到很重要的作用。checkpoins为ML模型拍一个快照，并且存储它在一个不易失的内存中，这样checkpoints就可以用于故障恢复，以保证快速的训练过程。此外，checkpoints还被用于在线训练，以通过持续学习提高推理预测的准确性。 ### 挑战 鉴于模型尺寸庞大且不断增加，checkpoint的频率被存储的写带宽和容量所限制。当checkpoint被远端存储所维护（这也是一些工业化配置的场景），checkpoints频率也会被网络带宽所限制。 ### 工作 作者提出了Check-N-Run，一个facebook的训练大型ML模型的可扩展checkpointing系统。 因为Check-N-Run应用于长时间运行的ML任务，作者聚焦于checkpointing推荐模型，它是有着TB级模型大小的当前最大的ML模型。 Check-N-Run主要使用了两个技术来解决尺寸和带宽挑战： - 首先，它使用差异化checkpointing，可以追踪和检查模型的修改部分。差异化checkpointing在推荐模型的情景中是十分重要的，因为只有一部分模型（以嵌入表存储）会在每次迭代中被更新。 - 其次，Check-N-Run在不降低训练准确度的前提下，利用了量化技术来极大地减小了checkpoint的大小。 ### 实验 这些技术让Check-N-Run在facebook的真实模型上，将需要的带宽减小了6到17倍、需要的容量减小了2.5到8倍，因此极大地提升了checkpoint的能力，并且减小了所有权（ownership）的总开销。 ### 原文摘要 Checkpoints play an important role in training long running machine learning (ML) models. Checkpoints take a snapshot of an ML model and store it in a non-volatile memory so that they can be used to recover from failures to ensure rapid training progress. In addition, they are used for online training to improve inference prediction accuracy with continuous learning. Given the large and ever-increasing model sizes, checkpoint frequency is often bottlenecked by the storage write bandwidth and capacity. When checkpoints are maintained on remote storage, as is the case with many industrial settings, they are also bottlenecked by network bandwidth. We present Check-N-Run, a scalable checkpointing system for training large ML models at Facebook. While Check-N-Run is applicable to long running ML jobs, we focus on checkpointing recommendation models which are currently the largest ML models with Terabytes of model size. Check-N-Run uses two primary techniques to address the size and bandwidth challenges. First, it applies differential checkpointing, which tracks and checkpoints the modified part of the model. Differential checkpointing is particularly valuable in the context of recommendation models where only a fraction of the model (stored as embedding tables) is updated on each iteration. Second, Check-N-Run leverages quantization techniques to significantly reduce the checkpoint size, without degrading training accuracy. These techniques allow Check-N-Run to reduce the required write bandwidth by 6-17x and the required capacity by 2.5-8xon real-world models at Facebook, and thereby significantly improve checkpoint capabilities while reducing the total cost of ownership.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#16][NSDI'22]使用SpiderMon进行闭环网络性能监控和诊断
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Detecting Ephemeral Optical Events with OpTel ### 背景 数据中心里的性能分析和诊断很重要。 ### 挑战 现有的监控系统不显式地聚焦于后续分析。 - “查询驱动”的监控系统必须预配置一个静态查询，但是很难达到全覆盖，因为很难知道后续的分析。 - 地毯式的监控系统有高覆盖率但是它们收集了过量的数据。 ### 工作 SpiderMon，一个结合监控和后续分析在一个闭环内的系统，可以同时实现低开销和高覆盖。 ### 实验结果 在Tofino硬件交换机和BMv2软件交换机上做了实验，表明SpiderMon能够在低开销的情况下，精准和快速地诊断性能问题。 ### 原文摘要 Performance monitoring and diagnosis are essential for data centers. The emergence of programmable switches has led to the development of a slew of monitoring systems, but most of them do not explicitly target posterior diagnosis. On one hand, “query-driven” monitoring systems must be pre-configured with a static query, but it is difficult to achieve high coverage because the right query for posterior diagnosis may not be known in advance. On the other hand, “blanket” monitoring systems have high coverage as they always collect telemetry data from all switches, but they collect excessive data. SpiderMon is a system that co-designs monitoring and posterior diagnosis in a closed loop to achieve low overhead and high coverage simultaneously, by leveraging “wait-for” relations to guide its operations. We evaluate SpiderMon in both Tofino hardware and BMv2 software switches and show that SpiderMon diagnoses performance problems accurately and quickly with low overhead.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#15][NSDI'22]使用OpTel检测短暂的光学事件
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Detecting Ephemeral Optical Events with OpTel ### 背景 光骨干网的衰退或失败事件会影响云服务的服务级别协议（service level agreement, SLA）。迅速地检测和排查这些事件以最小化它们的影响是很很重要的。 ### 挑战 现有的遥测系统基于比较玄学（arcane）的工具（如SNMP），并且使用供应商指定的控制器来收集光数据，这影响了这些系统的灵活性和可扩展性。结果是，它们不能按时收集需要的数据，以及不能以很及时的方式排查出衰退或失败事件。 ### 工作 设计和实现了OpTel，一个光遥测系统，使用一个集中式的供货商无感知（vendor-agnostic）的控制器来以流方式收集光数据。 具体的，它在光设备和控制器之间提供了灵活的供应商无感知的接口，并且从设备卸载数据管理任务（如创建一个查询表）到控制器上。结果是，OpTel可以收集秒级别的细粒度数据。 ### 实验 它以及在腾讯的光骨干网上运行了超过六个月。细粒度的数据收集可以检测出短生命周期的事件（即转瞬即逝的事件）。和现有的遥测系统相比，OpTel精准地测量了超过两倍的光事件。它也能够在数秒内排查这些事件，比最先进方案快几个数量级。 ### 原文摘要 Degradation or failure events in optical backbone networks affect the service level agreements for cloud services. It is critical to detect and troubleshoot these events promptly to minimize their impact. Existing telemetry systems rely on arcane tools (e.g., SNMP) and vendor-specific controllers to collect optical data, which affects both the flexibility and scale of these systems. As a result, they fail to collect the required data on time to detect and troubleshoot degradation or failure events in a timely fashion. This paper presents the design and implementation of OpTel, an optical telemetry system, that uses a centralized vendor-agnostic controller to collect optical data in a streaming fashion. More specifically, it offers flexible vendor-agnostic interfaces between the optical devices and the controller and offloads data-management tasks (e.g., creating a queryable database) from the devices to the controller. As a result, OpTel enables the collection of fine-grained optical telemetry data at the one-second granularity. It has been running in Tencent's optical backbone network for the past six months. The fine-grained data collection enables the detection of short-lived events (i.e., ephemeral events). Compared to existing telemetry systems, OpTel accurately detects 2x more optical events. It also enables troubleshooting of these optical events in a few seconds, which is orders of magnitude faster than the state-of-the-art.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#14][NSDI'22]一个基于任务抽样学习的集群工作调度案例
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 ## A Case for Task Sampling based Learning for Cluster Job Scheduling ### 背景 准确地估计任务的运行时属性的能力让一个调度器能够高效地调度工作（job）。当前最先进的在线集群工作调度器使用的是基于历史的学习，该方法使用过去的任务执行信息来预测新到来工作的运行时属性。 ### 挑战 然而，随着集群技术（在软件和硬件方面）的快速发展以及变化的用户输入，工作的运行时属性会随着时间变化，这导致了不精准地预测。 ### 工作 在本文中，作者通过主动采集和调度每个工作的一小部分任务（task），探索了实时学习运行时工作属性的潜力和限制。 这样的基于任务采集的方法利用了相同工作的各个任务运行时属性的相似性，是对变化的工作行为固有免疫的。 ### 实验 分析和对3个有着不同偏移（skew）和工作分布的产品级trace的实验分析表明，在空间内学习可以大幅度地提高准确率。 作者在Azure仿真和试验床上进行了实验，在3个产品级的集群trace的情况下，两种针对通用工作调度器的两种学习方法表明，尽管有着在线开销，在空间内学习与最先进的基于历史的预测其相比，能够减少1.28倍、1.56倍和1.32倍的平均工作完成时间。 最后，作者展示了基于采样的学习如何扩展至调度DAG任务，并且实现与先进的基于历史的预测其相似的加速。 ### 原文摘要 The ability to accurately estimate job runtime properties allows a scheduler to effectively schedule jobs. State-of-the-art online cluster job schedulers use history-based learning, which uses past job execution information to estimate the runtime properties of newly arrived jobs. However, with fast-paced development in cluster technology (in both hardware and software) and changing user inputs, job runtime properties can change over time, which lead to inaccurate predictions. In this paper, we explore the potential and limitation of real-time learning of job runtime properties, by proactively sampling and scheduling a small fraction of the tasks of each job. Such a task-sampling-based approach exploits the similarity among runtime properties of the tasks of the same job and is inherently immune to changing job behavior. Our analytical and experimental analysis of 3 production traces with different skew and job distribution shows that learning in space can be substantially more accurate. Our simulation and testbed evaluation on Azure of the two learning approaches anchored in a generic job scheduler using 3 production cluster job traces shows that despite its online overhead, learning in space reduces the average Job Completion Time (JCT) by 1.28x, 1.56x, and 1.32x compared to the prior-art history-based predictor. Finally, we show how sampling-based learning can be extended to schedule DAG jobs and achieve similar speedups over the prior-art history-based predictor.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#13][NSDI'22]BlueBird：面向裸金属云服务的高性能SDN
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 ## Bluebird: High-performance SDN for Bare-metal Cloud Services ### 背景 裸金属云服务是一种IaaS（Infrastructure as a Service，基础设施即服务），能够为用户提供专用的服务器硬件，以及其它云中共享基础设施（包括网络和存储）的访问权。 ### 工作 作者介绍了设计、实现、部署Bluebird的经验，Bluebird是Azure的裸金属云服务的一个高性能网络虚拟化系统。 Bluebird使用高性能可编程交换ASIC（专用集成电路）构建数据面，这个设计保证了Azure网络虚拟化所需要的高性能、可扩展性和转发能力。 Bluebird使用了一些完善的技术原理来保证可扩展性和高可用性，包括路由缓存、设备抽象和本地代理到远程控制器的解耦。 ### 实验 Bluebird系统已经在Azure运行超过两年时间。在这期间，它服务了数千个裸金属租户节点，并在保证每个启用Bluebird的SDN交换机小于1us的最大时延的前提下，提供了裸金属服务器的全线速网卡（最高达100Gbps）。作者分享了在Azure运行裸金属服务的经验，以及用于支持bluebird交换机的P4数据面程序。 ### 原文摘要 The bare-metal cloud service is a type of IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service) that offers dedicated server hardware to customers along with access to other shared infrastructure in the cloud, including network and storage. This paper presents our experiences in designing, implementing, and deploying Bluebird, the high-performance network virtualization system for the bare-metal cloud service on Azure. Bluebird's data plane is built using high-performance programmable switch ASICs. This design allows us to ensure the high performance, scale, and custom forwarding capabilities necessary for network virtualization on Azure. Bluebird employs a few well-established technical principles in the control plane that ensure scalability and high availability, including route caching, device abstraction, and architectural decoupling of switch-local agents from a remote controller. The Bluebird system has been running on Azure for more than two years. During this time, it has served thousands of bare-metal tenant nodes and delivered full line-rate NIC speed of bare-metal servers of up to 100Gb/s while ensuring less than 1µs of maximum latency at each Bluebird-enabled SDN switch. We share our experiences of running bare-metal services on Azure, along with the P4 data plane program used in the Bluebird-enabled switches.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#12][NSDI'22]背压流量控制
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 ## Backpressure Flow Control ### 背景 随着时延敏感型流量、更大（fatter）的链路和非常突发的流的增长，数据中心网络中高效的拥塞控制变得越来越具有挑战性。 ### 挑战 DCTCP和DCQCN等广泛部署的算法，在很多可信场景中远远没有达到最优值，特别是对于尾部延迟来说。许多操作员通过让他们的网络运行在低负载来补偿这一点，这极大地增大了开销。 ### 工作 在本文中，作者认为他们已经到达了端到端拥塞控制的实际极限。作者提出、实现和评估了一个叫做背压流控（Backpressure Flow Control，BFC）的新型拥塞控制架构。 BFC提供了逐跳逐流的流量控制，有着有界的状态、常数时间的交换机操作和对缓存和队列的小心使用。 ### 实验 作者通过在Tofino2（一个先进的基于P4的可编程硬件交换机）上实现BFC演示了它的可行性。 在仿真中，作者表明即使在高网络负载和incast cross流等富有挑战的场景下，BFC也能实现近乎最优的吞吐和尾部时延行为。 与已部署的端到端方案相比，BFC对短流实现了2.3-60倍低的尾部时延，对长流实现了1.6-5倍好的平均完成时间。 ### 原文摘要 Effective congestion control for data center networks is becoming increasingly challenging with a growing amount of latency-sensitive traffic, much fatter links, and extremely bursty traffic. Widely deployed algorithms, such as DCTCP and DCQCN, are still far from optimal in many plausible scenarios, particularly for tail latency. Many operators compensate by running their networks at low average utilization, dramatically increasing costs. In this paper, we argue that we have reached the practical limits of end-to-end congestion control. Instead, we propose, implement, and evaluate a new congestion control architecture called Backpressure Flow Control (BFC). BFC provides per-hop per-flow flow control, but with bounded state, constant-time switch operations, and careful use of buffers and queues. We demonstrate BFC’s feasibility by implementing it on Tofino2, a state-of-the-art P4-based programmable hardware switch. In simulation, we show that BFC achieves near optimal throughput and tail latency behavior even under challenging conditions such as high network load and incast cross traffic. Compared to deployed end-to-end schemes, BFC achieves 2.3 - 60× lower tail latency for short flows and 1.6 - 5× better average completion time for long flows.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#11][NSDI'22]RDMA是图灵完备的，只是我们还不知道而已！
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## RDMA is Turing complete, we just did not know it yet! ### 背景 目前，分布式系统越来越流行利用offload来减小CPU的负载。其中，远程直接内存访问（Remote Direct Memory Access, RDMA）offload是特别流行的。 ### 挑战 然而，RDMA在处理超出简单远程内存访问的复杂offload时，仍然需要CPU的干预。这样，offload的潜力就被限制，并且基于RDMA的系统通常不得不围绕这些限制做工作。 ### 工作 提出了RedN，一个有原则的（principled）、实用的实现复杂RDMAoffload的方法，不需要任何对硬件的修改。 使用自我修改（self-modifying）的RDMA链，作者提升现有的RDMA动作接口为[图灵完备](http://link.zhihu.com/?target=https%3A//zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%25E5%259C%2596%25E9%259D%2588%25E5%25AE%258C%25E5%2582%2599%25E6%2580%25A7)的编程抽象集合。 探索了商用RDMA网卡在offload复杂性和性能方面的可能性。 展示了如何结合这些RDMA链到应用，例如Memcached的key-value存储，允许卸载复杂的任务如键查询。 ### 实验 与最先进的使用RDMA原语的键值对设计（如FaRM-KV）相比，RedN可以减少最多2.6x倍的key-value查询延迟，与传统的基于RDMA的RPC相比也一样。此外，与这些基准方案相比，RedN提供了性能隔离，在存在性能竞争的情况下，可以减小至多35x的延迟，同时能够提供应用OS故障恢复力和对崩溃的处理。 ### 原文摘要 It is becoming increasingly popular for distributed systems to exploit offload to reduce load on the CPU. Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA) offload, in particular, has become popular. However, RDMA still requires CPU intervention for complex offloads that go beyond simple remote memory access. As such, the offload potential is limited and RDMA-based systems usually have to work around such limitations. We present RedN, a principled, practical approach to implementing complex RDMA offloads, without requiring any hardware modifications. Using self-modifying RDMA chains, we lift the existing RDMA verbs interface to a Turing complete set of programming abstractions. We explore what is possible in terms of offload complexity and performance with a commodity RDMA NIC. We show how to integrate these RDMA chains into applications, such as the Memcached key-value store, allowing us to offload complex tasks such as key lookups. RedN can reduce the latency of key-value get operations by up to 2.6× compared to state-of-the-art KV designs that use one-sided RDMA primitives (e.g., FaRM-KV), as well as traditional RPC-over-RDMA approaches. Moreover, compared to these baselines, RedN provides performance isolation and, in the presence of contention, can reduce latency by up to 35× while providing applications with failure resiliency to OS and process crashes.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#10][NSDI'22]Tiara：一个针对有状态四层负载均衡的可扩展高效硬件加速架构
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Tiara: A Scalable and Efficient Hardware Acceleration Architecture for Stateful Layer-4 Load Balancing ### 背景 有状态的四层负载均衡器（Load Balancer, LB）被部署在数据中心边界，以分发互联网流量到后端的真实服务器（real server）。 ### 挑战 为了驾驭Tbps级别的流量，传统的软件LB使用很多昂贵的服务器扩大规模。最近交换机加速的LB高效的扩展，但是没能将大量的并发流卸载至片上SRAM中。 ### 工作 提出了Tiara，一个有状态四层LB的硬件架构，旨在不对流量模式做任何假设的前提下，支持高速流量（>1Tbps）和高并发流（>10M）。 Tiara的三层架构充分利用了有状态LB的异构硬件，包括快路径的可编程交换机和FPGA，以及慢路径的X86服务器。 Tiara的核心思想是划分LB的快路径为内存密集型任务（真实服务器选择）和吞吐密集型任务（数据包封装/解封装），并且分别映射它们到最合适的硬件（即映射真实服务器选择到用有大带宽内存的FPGA，映射数据包封装/解封装到高吞吐的可编程交换机）。 ### 实验 实现了全功能的Tiara原型，实验表明在高开销、能源和空间效率的情况下，Tiara可以实现非常高的性能（1.6Tbps的吞吐、80M并发流、1.8M每秒的新连接和在一个装有8个FPGA的服务器上的快路径上小于4us的时延） ### 原文摘要 Stateful layer-4 load balancers (LB) are deployed at datacenter boundaries to distribute Internet traffic to backend real servers. To steer terabits per second traffic, traditional software LBs scale out with many expensive servers. Recent switch-accelerated LBs scale up efficiently, but fail to offload a massive number of concurrent flows into limited on-chip SRAMs. This paper presents Tiara, a hardware architecture for stateful layer-4 LBs that aims to support a high traffic rate (> 1 Tbps), a large number of concurrent flows (> 10M), and many new connections per second (> 1M), without any assumption on traffic patterns. The three-tier architecture of Tiara makes the best use of heterogeneous hardware for stateful LBs, including a programmable switch and FPGAs for the fast path and x86 servers for the slow path. The core idea of Tiara is to divide the LB fast path into a memory-intensive task (real server selection) and a throughput-intensive task (packet encap/decap), and map them into the most suitable hardware, respectively (i.e., map real server selection into FPGA with large high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and packet encap/decap into a high-throughput programmable switch). We have implemented a fully functional Tiara prototype, and experiments show that Tiara can achieve extremely high performance (1.6 Tbps throughput, 80M concurrent flows, 1.8M new connections per second, and less than 4 us latency in the fast path) in a holistic server equipped with 8 FPGA cards, with high cost, energy, and space efficiency.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#9][NSDI'22]Ekay：边缘计算服务器上视频分析模型的持续学习
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Ekya: Continuous Learning of Video Analytics Models on Edge Compute Servers ### 背景 视频分析应用使用边缘计算服务器来处理视频。用于推断的压缩模型被部署在边缘服务器上，经历着数据漂移，即实时视频流数据与训练数据发生了偏移。持续学习通过周期性的在新数据上重新训练模型来处理数据漂移问题。 ### 挑战 要能同时支持边缘服务器上的推断和重训练任务，着就需要在重训练模型的准确性和推断准确性之间的基本权衡间做出探索。 ### 工作 提出Ekya，能够在多个模型间的这种权衡中做出平衡，使用了一个微型测绘器（micro-profiler）来识别出最需要重训练的模型。 ### 实验 Ekya的准确度增益比baseline调度器高出29%；并且在实现相同准确度的情况下，baseline需要比Ekya超出4倍的GPU资源。 ### 原文摘要 Video analytics applications use edge compute servers for processing videos. Compressed models that are deployed on the edge servers for inference suffer from data drift where the live video data diverges from the training data. Continuous learning handles data drift by periodically retraining the models on new data. Our work addresses the challenge of jointly supporting inference and retraining tasks on edge servers, which requires navigating the fundamental tradeoff between the retrained model’s accuracy and the inference accuracy. Our solution Ekya balances this tradeoff across multiple models and uses a micro-profiler to identify the models most in need of retraining. Ekya’s accuracy gain compared to a baseline scheduler is 29% higher, and the baseline requires 4× more GPU resources to achieve the same accuracy as Ekya.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#8][NSDI'22]Cocktail：一种云上模型服务的多维度优化方法
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Cocktail: A Multidimensional Optimization for Model Serving in Cloud ### 背景 随着为广泛的应用服务调整ML模型的需求的日益增长，在公有云环境下，服务这些模型的框架能够在最小的延迟和较小的部署开销的情况下提供高预测准确度变得很重要。 ### 挑战 除了有着高延迟，之前在这个领域的工作被各个模型提供的准确度严重限制住了。然而，实时动态地选择合适的模型以满足准确度是一个很重要的问题。 ### 工作 针对此，提出了CockTail，一个低成本、基于合并计算的模型服务框架。 CockTail由两个核心组件组成： - 一个动态的模型选择框架，可在满足准确度和延迟要求的同时，减少合并时的模型数 - 一个自适应的资源管理（Resource Management, RM）框架，可部署一个分布式的主动自动缩放测量，来高效地为模型分配资源。RM框架利用瞬时的VM实例来减少在公有云的部署开销。 ### 实验 在AWS EC2平台上实现的原型和基于多种负载的详尽的实验表明，CockTail与最先进的模型服务框架相比，能在提供2x的时延减小和对于最高96%的请求能满足目标准确度要求的同时， 可以减小1.45x的部署开销。 ### 原文摘要 With a growing demand for adopting ML models for a variety of application services, it is vital that the frameworks serving these models are capable of delivering highly accurate predictions with minimal latency along with reduced deployment costs in a public cloud environment. Despite high latency, prior works in this domain are crucially limited by the accuracy offered by individual models. Intuitively, model ensembling can address the accuracy gap by intelligently combining different models in parallel. However, selecting the appropriate models dynamically at runtime to meet the desired accuracy with low latency at minimal deployment cost is a nontrivial problem. Towards this, we propose Cocktail, a cost effective ensembling-based model serving framework. Cocktail comprises of two key components: (i) a dynamic model selection framework, which reduces the number of models in the ensemble, while satisfying the accuracy and latency requirements; (ii) an adaptive resource management (RM) framework that employs a distributed proactive autoscaling policy combined with importance sampling, to efficiently allocate resources for the models. The RM framework leverages transient virtual machine (VM) instances to reduce the deployment cost in a public cloud. A prototype implementation of Cocktail on the AWS EC2 platform and exhaustive evaluations using a variety of workloads demonstrate that {Cocktail} can reduce deployment cost by 1.45x, while providing 2x reduction in latency and satisfying the target accuracy for up to 96% of the requests, when compared to state-of-the-art model-serving frameworks.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#7][NSDI'22]CloudCluster：揭示云服务的功能结构
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## CloudCluster: Unearthing the Functional Structure of a Cloud Service ### 背景&挑战 当客户要求云提供商提供很好的工具来管理云服务时，云提供商会因为缺少对云服务功能的视野而受到阻碍；一个提供商经常只知道服务的VM（虚拟机）放在哪、虚拟网络是怎么配置的、VM是如何被提供的、VM之间是怎么通信的。 ### 工作 作者在本文中表明，使用VM与VM间的流量矩阵，可以挖掘出云服务的功能结构，并且使用它去给云服务管理江湖救急_（原文中的用词是aid cloud service management）_。 利用云服务在扩展性方面广为人知的设计模式（例如，复制、communication locality），作者表明对VM间的流量进行聚类可以得到云服务的功能结构。 作者的聚类算法CloudCluster必须克服由扩展性（云服务包含数以万计的VM）带来的挑战，并且必须对流量数据量和测量噪声的数量级的变化具有鲁棒性。为做到这一点，CloudCluster将特征缩放、维度减小和分层聚类做了创新的结合，实现了具有超过92%的同构性和完整性的聚类。 ### 实验 展示了CloudCluster可以被用于探索减小用户开销的可能性、识别异常流量和潜在的错误配置。 ### 原文摘要 In their quest to provide customers with good tools to manage cloud services, cloud providers are hampered by having very little visibility into cloud service functionality; a provider often only knows where VMs of a service are placed, how the virtual networks are configured, how VMs are provisioned, and how VMs communicate with each other. In this paper, we show that, using the VM-to-VM traffic matrix, we can unearth the_functional structure_of a cloud service and use it to aid cloud service management. Leveraging the observation that cloud services use well-known design patterns for scaling (_e.g._, replication, communication locality), we show that_clustering_the VM-to-VM traffic matrix yields the functional structure of the cloud service. Our clustering algorithm, CloudCluster, must overcome challenges imposed by scale (cloud services contain tens of thousands of VMs) and must be robust to orders-of-magnitude variability in traffic volume and measurement noise. To do this, CloudCluster uses a novel combination of feature scaling, dimensionality reduction, and hierarchical clustering to achieve clustering with over 92% homogeneity and completeness. We show that CloudCluster can be used to explore opportunities to reduce cost for customers, identify anomalous traffic and potential misconfigurations.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#6][NSDI'22]数据包的顺序很重要！通过故意延迟数据包提升应用性能
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Packet Order Matters! Improving Application Performance by Deliberately Delaying Packets ### 背景 数据中心越来越多地部署带有高速网卡的商用服务器，以保证低时延的通信。然而，在高速率下实现低延迟，很大程度上依赖于来的流量如何和系统缓存交互。当数据包需要被以连续的方式处理时，缓存可以释放出很好的作用。 ### 工作 **挑战** 系统地分析了时间和空间局部性对配备了高速网卡的商用服务器的性能影响，结果表明： - 即使在轻微缺少局部性的情况下，一系列被广泛部署的应用的性能大幅度的衰减 - 一个流量trace表明网络协议、驱动和交换机/路由器及时地将数据包分散，导致流量局部性很差 **解决方案** 为解决这些问题，构建了Reframer，一个故意延迟并重排序数据包以提升流量局部性的软件解决方案。 ### 实验 除了给部分包引入了微秒级的延迟，作者表明了Reframer增加了一个服务功能链最高84%的吞吐，减小了一个web服务器11%的流完成时间并增大了它20%的吞吐。 ### 原文摘要 Data centers increasingly deploy commodity servers with high-speed network interfaces to enable low-latency communication. However, achieving low latency at high data rates crucially depends on how the incoming traffic interacts with the system's caches. When packets that need to be processed in the same way are consecutive, i.e., exhibit high temporal and spatial locality, caches deliver great benefits. In this paper, we systematically study the impact of temporal and spatial traffic locality on the performance of commodity servers equipped with high-speed network interfaces. Our results show that (i) the performance of a variety of widely deployed applications degrade substantially with even the slightest lack of traffic locality, and (ii) a traffic trace from our organization reveals poor traffic locality as networking protocols, drivers, and the underlying switching/routing fabric spread packets out in time (reducing locality). To address these issues, we built Reframer, a software solution that deliberately delays packets and reorders them to increase traffic locality. Despite introducing μs-scale delays of some packets, we show that Reframer increases the throughput of a network service chain by up to 84% and reduces the flow completion time of a web server by 11% while improving its throughput by 20%.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#5][NSDI'22] 差异化网络分析
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Differential Network Analysis ### 背景 网络在持续改变。为避免严重后果，操作员需要知道网络控制面的潜在变化是否会造成端到端转发行为的不想要的变化。例如，配置变化前和变化后的哪对主机的连通性会受到影响？ ### 挑战 控制面验证器不适合回答这样的问题，因为它们仅仅做了快照，然后检查它是否遵守显式指定的属性，而不是量化对端到端转发行为的影响。 ### 工作 主张一个新的控制面分析流程，可以让不同成为一等公民。Different Network Analysis (DNA，差异化网络分析)获取控制平面变化，增量计算控制面和数据面的状态，然后输出相应的在端到端行为上的差异。将计算分为三个阶段：控制面仿真、数据面建模、属性检查，并且分别利用差异化数据流编编程框架、增量数据流验证、定制化图算法来让各个阶段是增量的。 ### 实验 仿真结果表明人造和真实的控制面变化下，DNA可以在数秒内计算可达性的差异，比最先进的数据面验证器快了3个数量级以上。 ### 原文摘要 Networks are constantly changing. To avoid outages, operators need to know whether prospective changes in a network's control plane will cause undesired changes in end-to-end forwarding behavior. For example, which pairs of end hosts are reachable before a configuration change but unreachable after the change? Control plane verifiers are ill-suited for answering such questions because they operate on a single snapshot to check its "compliance" with "explicitly specified" properties, instead of quantifying the "differences" in "affected" end-to-end forwarding behaviors. We argue for a new control plane analysis paradigm that makes differences first class citizens. Differential Network Analysis (DNA) takes control plane changes, incrementally computes control and data plane state, and outputs consequent differences in end-to-end behavior. We break the computation into three stages---control plane simulation, data plane modeling, and property checking---and leverage differential dataflow programming frameworks, incremental data plane verification, and customized graph algorithms, respectively, to make each stage incremental. Evaluations using both real and synthetic control plane changes demonstrate that DNA can compute the resulting differences in reachability in a few seconds---up to 3 orders of magnitude faster than state-of-the-art control plane verifiers.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#4][NSDI'22] GearBox: 一个近似加权公平队列的分层数据包调度器
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Gearbox: A Hierarchical Packet Scheduler for Approximate Weighted Fair Queuing ### 背景 带宽分配和性能隔离对实现网络虚拟化和保证数据中心服务质量很重要，WFQ（Weighed Fair Queuing，加权公平队列）可以实现带宽分配和性能隔离 ### 挑战 然而，在大规模高速网络系统中实现WFQ很困难，因为调度很复杂且需要的队列数很多。 ### 工作 提出了GearBox，一个针对下一代可编程交换机和智能网卡的调度器原语，实际上是一个近似的WFQ。GearBox由一系列逻辑分层的队列等级组成，可以使用相对少的FIFO队列，适应很大范围的包完成时间。GearBox的入队和出队操作有着O(1)的时间复杂度，使其能够适用于高速线速。GearBox通过允许与严格WFQ轻微不同的包离开时间，提供了简单性和高性能。展示了GearBox的正态离开时间的偏移性是受限制的，并且在带宽分配和流完成时间上只有轻微的影响。 ### 实验 做了NS2仿真和FPGA仿真。NS2结果表明很接近标准WFQ，能实现加权最大-最小公平带宽分配和流量隔离。提供了与理想WFQ相近的FCT性能。在FPGA上的实验表明能够实现线速，消耗了少于1%的逻辑资源和4%的内存。 ### 原文摘要 Bandwidth allocation and performance isolation are crucial to achieving network virtualization and guaranteeing service quality in data centers as well as other network systems. Weighted Fair Queuing (WFQ) can achieve customized bandwidth allocation and flow isolation; however, its implementation in large-scale high-speed network systems is very challenging due to the high complexity of the scheduling and the large number of queues required. This paper proposes Gearbox, a scheduler primitive for next-generation programmable switches and smart NICs that practically approximates WFQ. Gearbox consists of a logical hierarchy of queuing levels, which accommodate a wide range of packet departure times using a relatively small number of FIFOs. Gearbox's enqueue and dequeue operations have O(1) time complexity, which makes it suitable to cope with high-speed line rates. Gearbox provides its simplicity and performance advantages by allowing slight discrepancies in packet departure time from strict WFQ. We show that Gearbox's normalized departure time discrepancy is bounded and has a negligible impact on bandwidth allocation and flow completion time (FCT). We implement Gearbox in NS2 and in VHDL, targeted to a Xilinx Alveo U250 card with an XCVU13P FPGA. The NS2 evaluation results show that Gearbox closely approximates WFQ and achieves weighted max-min fairness in bandwidth allocation as well as flow isolation. Gearbox provides FCT performance comparable to ideal WFQ. The Gearbox FPGA prototype runs at 350MHz and achieves full line rate for 100GbE with packets larger than 123 bytes. Gearbox consumes less than 1% of the FPGA's logic resources and less than 4% of its internal block memory.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#3][NSDI'22] 野生的ML即服务：在大规模异构GPU集群中的负载分析和调度
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## MLaaS in the Wild: Workload Analysis and Scheduling in Large-Scale Heterogeneous GPU Clusters ### 背景 随着机器学习技术的持续进步和可用的大规模数据集，科技公司正在部署ML-as-a-Service(MLaaS)云，该云有着许多异构的CPU，来提供一个主机的ML应用。 ### 挑战 然而，在异构GPU集群中运行不同的ML负载会带来许多挑战。 ### 工作 从阿里巴巴6000个GPU的集群中分析了两个月的trace中的特征，解释了集群调度中的挑战，包括低CPU利用率、长队列延迟、难以调度任务、负载不均衡、CPU瓶颈。 描述了作者的解决方案并指出一些待解决的问题。 发布了trace，是在负载和集群规模方面最全面的trace。 ### 原文摘要 With the sustained technological advances in machine learning (ML) and the availability of massive datasets recently, tech companies are deploying large ML-as-a-Service (MLaaS) clouds, often with heterogeneous GPUs, to provision a host of ML applications. However, running diverse ML workloads in heterogeneous GPU clusters raises a number of challenges. In this paper, we present a characterization study of a two-month workload trace collected from a production MLaaS cluster with over 6,000 GPUs in Alibaba. We explain the challenges posed to cluster scheduling, including the low GPU utilization, the long queueing delays, the presence of hard-to-schedule tasks demanding high-end GPUs with picky scheduling requirements, the imbalance load across heterogeneous machines, and the potential bottleneck on CPUs. We describe our current solutions and call for further investigations into the challenges that remain open to address. We have released the trace for public access, which is the most comprehensive in terms of the workloads and cluster scale.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#2][NSDI'22] 在可变带宽网络下的拜占庭共识
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Byzantine Consensus on Variable Bandwidth Networks ### 背景 区块链的成功让拜占庭容错共识（Byzantine fault tolerant, BFT）协议在广域网上大规模部署。 ### 挑战 这样的网络的核心特点在于在节点和时间之间变化的通信带宽。 ### 工作 提出DispersedLedger（分散式账本），一个异步的BFT，能够在这样变化的网络带宽的情况下提供近乎最优的吞吐。 ### 实验 实验表明增大了吞吐，降低了时延。 ### 原文摘要 The success of blockchains has sparked interest in large-scale deployments of Byzantine fault tolerant (BFT) consensus protocols over wide area networks. A central feature of such networks is variable communication bandwidth across nodes and across time. We present DispersedLedger, an asynchronous BFT protocol that provides near-optimal throughput in the presence of such variable network bandwidth. The core idea of DispersedLedger is to enable nodes to propose, order, and agree on blocks of transactions without having to download their full content. By enabling nodes to agree on an ordered log of blocks, with a guarantee that each block is available within the network and unmalleable, DispersedLedger decouples bandwidth-intensive block downloads at different nodes, allowing each to make progress at its own pace. We build a full system prototype and evaluate it on real-world and emulated networks. Our results on a geo-distributed wide-area deployment across the Internet shows that DispersedLedger achieves 2x better throughput and 74% reduction in latency compared to HoneyBadger, the state-of-the-art asynchronous protocol.

title: [网络领域顶会追踪系列#1][NSDI'22] 资源约束下的模块化交换机编程
text: 网络领域顶会追踪 计算机网络 论文阅读 NSDI 技术札记 > 本系列为个人论文阅读笔记，大多数应该是对顶会摘要的个人菜鸟翻译，旨在让感兴趣的朋友能快速浏览、获取信息。如有错误或心得，欢迎在评论区交流指正！ ## Modular Switch Programming Under Resource Constraints ### 背景 可编程网络支持很多应用，包括接入控制、路由、监控、缓存、同步等。随着应用的需求提升，交换机数据面上的资源竞争也随之提升。 ### 挑战 塞应用进交换机会导致很多问题，包含非模块化编程、令人失望的不断地重复编译-debug过程、对资源的非最优利用等问题。 ### 所做工作 - 提出了一个P4交换机的扩展，P4All。P4All允许程序员定义弹性的数据结构，这些数据结构可以自动伸展以充分利用交换机中的可用空间。这些数据结构由符号化原语（可以参数化结构的大小和形状）和目标函数（可以量化形状变化时的收益或损失）定义。一个顶层优化的函数指定了如何在数据结构或应用之间分享资源。 - 通过建立一系列可重用的数据结构，包括哈希表，布隆过滤器，sketch和key-value存储，演示了作者的设计的固有模块化性和高效性，并且使用这些数据结构到很多应用中。 - 通过依赖分析、解循环、线性和非线性约束生成以及约束求解的结合，展示了如何使用P4All编译器。 - 评估了P4All编译器的性能，实验结果表明一系列弹性应用可以在最多几分钟内编译进P4。 ### 原文摘要 Programmable networks support a wide variety of applications, including access control, routing, monitoring, caching, and synchronization. As demand for applications grows, so does resource contention within the switch data plane. Cramming applications onto a switch is a challenging task that often results in non-modular programming, frustrating “trial and error” compile-debug cycles, and suboptimal use of resources. In this paper, we present P4All, an extension of P4 that allows programmers to define elastic data structures that stretch automatically to make optimal use of available switch resources. These data structures are defined using symbolic primitives (that parameterize the size and shape of the structure) and objective functions (that quantify the value gained or lost as that shape changes). A top-level optimization function specifies how to share resources amongst data structures or applications. We demonstrate the inherent modularity and effectiveness of our design by building a range of reusable elastic data structures including hash tables, Bloom filters, sketches, and key-value stores, and using those structures within larger applications. We show how to implement the P4All compiler using a combination of dependency analysis, loop unrolling, linear and non-linear constraint generation, and constraint solving. We evaluate the compiler’s performance, showing that a range of elastic programs can be compiled to P4 in few minutes at most, but usually less.

title: 使用python的pyroute2在tc clsact在入口（ingress）和出口（egress）处添加bpf程序
text: tc ebpf 计算机网络 技术札记 # 先上结论 使用parent参数来控制入口（ffff:fff2）或是出口（ffff:fff3）。 ```python # add ingress clsact ip.tc("add-filter", "bpf", idx, ":1", fd=fd, name="myprog", parent="ffff:fff2", classid=1, direct_action=True) # add egress clsact ip.tc("add-filter", "bpf", idx, ":1", fd=fd, name="myprog", parent="ffff:fff3", classid=1, direct_action=True) ``` # 前置知识 > 参考资料：tc基础、tc的direct-action模式及tc clsact （这里做简要复述，主要还是要看这个参考资料） tc基础—使用tc时的大概几个步骤： 1. 创建队列规则qdisc。 2. 创建类别class，并attach到qdisc 3. 创建filter，并attach到qdisc。用于对流量分类，并将包分发至不同的class 4. 可给filter加action，决定丢包、转发等动作 tc的direct-action模式是将classifier的分类功能和action的动作功能合二唯一的一个功能，简化了流程，提升了性能。 tc clsact是一种队列规则qdisc，可以在入口（ingress）和出口（egress）处以direct-action模式attach bpf程序。 # 背景 & 问题 使用bcc作为ebpf前端编程时，产生了如何在tc钩子处的入口和出口处添加bpf程序的疑问。 在bcc的examples里找到了一个在tc入口处丢弃所有包的例子，该例子中，这样在tc入口处加载bpf程序： ```python ip = pyroute2.IPRoute() ipdb = pyroute2.IPDB(nl=ip) idx = ipdb.interfaces[device].index ip.tc("add", "clsact", idx) ip.tc("add-filter", "bpf", idx, ":1", fd=fn.fd, name=fn.name, parent="ffff:fff2", classid=1, direct_action=True) ``` 看的人很疑惑，完全找不到关于入口/出口的关键字。 # 解决 ## pyroute2例程 去翻了pyroute2关于clsact的官方文档，里面有这样一段例程： ```python # BPF ingress/egress example using clsact qdisc: # open_bpf_fd is outside the scope of pyroute2 #fd = open_bpf_fd() eth0 = ip.get_links(ifname="eth0")[0] ip.tc("add", "clsact", eth0) # add ingress clsact ip.tc("add-filter", "bpf", idx, ":1", fd=fd, name="myprog", parent="ffff:fff2", classid=1, direct_action=True) # add egress clsact ip.tc("add-filter", "bpf", idx, ":1", fd=fd, name="myprog", parent="ffff:fff3", classid=1, direct_action=True) ``` 可以看到bcc的例程和pyroute2例程的公共点是入口处的程序都使用了ffff:fff2这个parent，另外pyroute2例程在出口处使用了ffff:fff3这个parent。 ## 小实验 于是自己运行代码跑了一下小实验，想看下不同的parent会有什么影响。结果除了ffff:fff2和ffff:fff3外的所有parent都会报`pr2modules.netlink.exceptions.NetlinkError: (2, 'No such file or directory')`错误。证明ffff:fff2和ffff:fff3应该是某个特定的数字。 ## tc clsact相关linux源码 去翻阅了linux tc clsact的commit记录，找到了以下代码： ```c #define TC_H_UNSPEC (0U) #define TC_H_ROOT (0xFFFFFFFFU) #define TC_H_INGRESS (0xFFFFFFF1U) +#define TC_H_CLSACT TC_H_INGRESS + +#define TC_H_MIN_INGRESS 0xFFF2U //ffff:fff2 +#define TC_H_MIN_EGRESS 0xFFF3U // ffff:fff3 ``` 这说明：**ffff:fff2和ffff:fff3是tc clsact的ingress和egress两个class的ID，因此加filter时对应的parent要写它两。因此，也就不难理解上述各个例程中的写法。**

title: celery执行池
text: celery 协程 多进程 任务队列 web开发 技术札记 # celery执行池 > 参考： > > [Celery Execution Pools: What is it all about?](https://www.distributedpython.com/2018/10/26/celery-execution-pool/) ## celery worker 使用`celery --app=`时，相当于启动了一个监督进程（supervisor process），worker自身不执行任何任务。它会产生一些子进程（或线程），这些进程（或线程）执行实际的任务。这些子进程（或线程）也被称为执行池（execution pool）。 执行池的大小决定了celery worker可以处理的任务数目。产生的进程（或线程）越多，可以并行处理的任务越多。 理论上来说，如果想尽快处理多个任务，就需要更大的执行池。但实际上的情况会复杂一些。执行池的大小取决于使用的是进程还是线程，而使用进程还是线程取决于要做的任务。 ## -pool选项 pool选项可选择使用进程还是线程。如下面的命令创建了100个协程 ```shell # start celery worker with the gevent pool ~$ celery worker --app=worker.app --pool=gevent --concurrency=100 ``` celery提供了四种执行池的实现： - prefork（不指定的话默认） - solo - eventlet - gevent 下面将讲解各个实现。 ### prefork prefork基于python的multiprocessing包实现。因此可以充分利用机器的多个处理器。 任务是CPU密集型的应用是可选择prefork pool。 如果不指定concurrency参数，将会使用与CPU数量一致的进程数。 ```shell # start celery worker with the prefork pool ~$ celery worker --app=worker.app ``` ### solo solo pool是有点特殊的执行池。严格的讲，solo pool不是基于进程或基于线程的。更严格的讲，solo pool违背了worker自身不执行任何任务的原则。 solo pool运行于worker process内。它内联运行，因此solo worker很快。但是它在执行任务时也会阻塞worker，这会对一些远程控制worker造成影响。 ```shell # start celery worker in solo mode ~$ celery worker --app=worker.app --pool=solo ``` ### eventlet和gevent celery支持两种基于线程的执行池：eventlet和gevent。这里，执行池在与celery worker自身相同的进程中运行。更精确地说，eventlet和gevent都使用greenlets，而不使用线程。 greenlets也被称为green线程(green threads)、协作线程（cooperative threads）或协程（coroutines）。它可以提供线程的功能，却不使用线程。线程由操作系统内核负责管理，操作系统使用一个通用目的的调度器来在线程间做切换，这种方式通常不是很高效。 协程在不依赖任何原生的操作系统能力的情况下模拟多线程环境。它在用户空间而非内核空间被管理。没有调度器在任何时刻抢先在你的线程间切换，相反，你的协程在你代码的指定点自愿或显式的将控制权交给另一个协程。 这使得协程擅长运行大量的非阻塞任务。 对于我们来说，使用eventlet或gevent pool的好处是使得celery worker可以做更多工作。这意味着我们不需要很多RAM来扩展规模，优化了我们worker的利用率。 ```shell # start celery worker using the gevent pool with 500 worker threads ~$ celery worker --app=worker.app --pool=gevent --concurreny=500 # start celery worker using the eventlet pool with 500 worker threads ~$ celery worker --app=worker.app --pool=eventlet --concurreny=500 ``` gevent和eventlet是python的包，它们的实现有差异。 ## –concurrency选项 为选择最佳的执行池，你需要理解你的任务是CPU密集型还是IO密集型的。CPU密集型的最好使用prefork执行池。I/O密集型的最好使用gevent/eventlet执行池。（solo执行池：我不要面子的吗？） 现在唯一的问题是：你需要启动多少个进程/线程？–concurrency选项决定了进程/线程的数量 ```shell # start celery worker using the prefork pool ~$ celery worker --app=worker.app --concurrency=2 ``` 上述命令启动了一个有prefork执行池的worker，该worker拥有两个进程。对于prefork池，进程数不应该超过CPU数。 如果`--concurrency`选项未设置，不管执行池的种类是什么，celery默认将其设置为CPU的数量。这个设定对与prefork执行池来说讲的通，但是它是具有一定误导性的。如果机器上有很多其他的进程，celery的进程数与CPU数量相同就不是一个好主意。 使用默认的concurrency选项对于gevent/eventlet池来说也很蠢。协程数由你决定，与CPU数目无关。 另一个特殊情况是solo pool，尽管可以在命令行提供`--concurrency`命令，但是它对于solo pool是无意义的。（怪不得项目里用solo pool + concurrency感觉无效） ## celery对于CPU密集型和I/O密集型混合任务的处理 建立两个队列，一个队列使用prefork执行池，用于处理CPU密集型任务；另一个队列使用gevent/eventlet执行池，用于处理IO密集型任务。不要忘了路由你的任务到正确的队列。

title: python subprocess模块学习笔记
